meta.source: Populated from general knowledge of UK tax law. NOT independently verified.
meta.warning: Every figure below must be checked against the current HMRC rates and thresholds page and the relevant Finance Act before it is used in any computation that informs a filing, a lender, or a decision. Rates change at Budgets, sometimes retrospectively. Set verified_on per parameter as you confirm each one.
meta.scope_note: Scotland and Wales set their own income tax rates / land transaction taxes (LBTT, LTT). This file covers England & NI only; see the 'unsupported' list.

personal_allowance.source: HMRC: Income Tax rates and Personal Allowances
personal_allowance.note: Frozen until at least April 2028 under announced policy - confirm.

pa_taper_threshold.note: Allowance reduced by £1 for every £2 of adjusted net income above this.

basic_rate_limit.note: Taxable income above the personal allowance.

higher_rate_limit.note: Point at which the additional rate begins.

bands.note: Upper bounds are cumulative taxable income after allowances.

dividend_allowance.note: A nil-rate band, not a true allowance - it still uses up band.

finance_cost_relief_rate.note: Residential landlord finance costs are not deductible; relief is a basic-rate tax reducer. This is the single largest driver of tax on personally-held geared residential property.

cash_basis_property_threshold.note: Cash basis is the default for property businesses below this; election available to use accruals.

annual_exempt_amount.note: Reduced from £6,000 (2023/24) and £12,300 (2022/23). Confirm current year.

badr_rate.note: Business Asset Disposal Relief. Rate was legislated to rise in steps - verify the rate for the actual disposal date, not the filing date.

residential_reporting_days.note: UK residential property disposals need a standalone CGT return AND payment on account within 60 days of completion. Missing this is one of the most common penalties in a property portfolio.

lower_limit.note: Divided by the number of associated companies plus one.

marginal_relief_fraction.note: 3/200. Applies between the lower and upper limits, giving a ~26.5% effective marginal rate in that band.

payment_due_months.note: 9 months and 1 day after the end of the accounting period for companies not in quarterly instalments.

return_due_months.note: CT600 due 12 months after the period end - later than the payment date.

class2_weekly_voluntary.note: Class 2 liability was removed for most; voluntary payment may still protect the State Pension record. Check before advising anyone to stop paying.

property_income_note.note: Property income is NOT subject to Class 4 NIC unless the activity amounts to a trade (e.g. serviced accommodation with substantial services). This distinction is fact-specific.

registration_threshold.note: Rolling 12-month test AND a forward 30-day test. Residential letting is exempt, so it usually does not count towards this - but commercial rent (if opted to tax) and serviced accommodation do.

residential_letting_treatment.note: Exempt supply - input VAT on related costs is generally irrecoverable.

residential_standard_bands.note: Thresholds changed on 1 April 2025. Rates depend on the EFFECTIVE DATE of the transaction (usually completion), not the exchange date.

additional_dwelling_surcharge.note: Higher rates for additional dwellings, added to every band including the nil band. Increased from 3% to 5% on 31 October 2024. A replacement of a main residence may be exempt, with a refund route if the old home sells within 3 years.

non_resident_surcharge.note: Non-UK residents. The SDLT residence test differs from the statutory residence test for income tax.

corporate_flat_rate.note: Flat rate where a company or other non-natural person buys a single dwelling above the threshold, unless a relief (e.g. property rental business) applies and is claimed.

non_residential_bands.note: Also applies to mixed-use property. HMRC challenges weak mixed-use claims aggressively - the non-residential element must be genuine.

max_price.note: No relief at all if the price exceeds this.

filing_days.note: SDLT return and payment due within 14 days of the effective date.

mdr_abolished.note: Multiple Dwellings Relief was abolished for transactions with an effective date on or after 1 June 2024. Treat any adviser recommending MDR on a current purchase as a red flag.

structures_and_buildings_allowance.note: Straight line. Reduces CGT base cost on disposal - claiming it is not free.

dwelling_house_restriction.note: No plant and machinery allowances for a dwelling house let residentially. Common and expensive error. Replacement of Domestic Items relief (ITTOIA 2005 s.311A) is the route instead.

self_assessment_online.value: 31 January following the end of the tax year

self_assessment_paper.value: 31 October following the end of the tax year

ct600.value: 12 months from the end of the accounting period

ct_payment.value: 9 months and 1 day from the end of the accounting period

individual_years.note: 5 years from the 31 January filing deadline where a return includes business or property income.

company_years.note: 6 years from the end of the accounting period.

itsa_threshold_2026.note: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax: qualifying income (turnover from self-employment PLUS gross property income, before expenses) above this from April 2026.

note.note: Gross property income counts towards the threshold, so a modest portfolio can be brought in even when profits are small after finance costs.

default_percent_of_revenue.note: 0.5% of revenue as a starting benchmark for review materiality. Judgement, not a rule - lower it where there is fraud risk or a covenant nearby.

unsupported_note: These are NOT gaps to be filled with an estimate. Each involves rules where a plausible-looking approximation produces a materially wrong answer, or where the outcome turns on facts the engine cannot see. The engine refuses to compute them and refers them out. That refusal is a feature.
